title.purpose: Page names and the launch heading.

play.purpose: The Play label in its square.

lead.purpose: Sublines, Library row names, the setup sentence, search.

block-name.purpose: Name inside a strip block, two lines max.

label.purpose: Block kind and state, strip group labels, table heads, fact terms.

motion.name: step
motion.purpose: Every state change: two frames, no easing.

motion.name: step-time
motion.purpose: Duration of background, border and colour changes on controls and blocks.

motion.name: busy-loop
motion.purpose: Mark panels (offset 360ms) and the active launch step while something is starting.

themes.mechanism: data-theme on the root element: milky (default), night, ashen; Settings also offers Match system (milky or night by prefers-color-scheme).

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action: flat, 36px, 2px corners, one tone step on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--control, #b9b7ae); border-radius:2px; background:var(--surface, #fbfbf9); color:var(--text, #141818); font:500 14px/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 90ms steps(2, jump-none); } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--raised, #e8e7e1); } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Text-colour fill for the main non-Play action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--text, #141818); border-radius:2px; background:var(--text, #141818); color:var(--ground, #f3f2ee); font:500 14px/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 90ms steps(2, jump-none); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--muted, #4f5553); border-color:var(--muted, #4f5553); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action, outlined in negative and set apart from the others.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--negative, #b4232a); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--negative, #b4232a); font:500 14px/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--negative, #b4232a) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Play
components.description: The 112px cyan square at the end of the strip; runs exactly what the strip shows.
components.html: <button class="ds-play"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 2.5v11l9-5.5z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>Play</button>
components.css: .ds-play { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; width:112px; height:112px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:var(--cyan, #18e6e4); color:var(--on-cyan, #0b1c1f); font:650 20px/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 90ms steps(2, jump-none); } .ds-play:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #18e6e4) 82%, var(--text, #141818)); } .ds-play:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Strip Block
components.description: A 112px square for one part of the setup: kind, name, state. Cyan when chosen or on, dashed when off.
components.css: .ds-strip { display:flex; gap:8px; padding:20px; background:var(--surface, #fbfbf9); border:1px solid var(--line, #dcdad3); border-radius:2px; } .ds-block { display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto; gap:4px; width:112px; height:112px; padding:8px; text-align:left; border:1px solid var(--control, #b9b7ae); border-radius:2px; background:var(--ground, #f3f2ee); color:var(--text, #141818); font-family:'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 90ms steps(2, jump-none), border-color 90ms steps(2, jump-none); } .ds-block:hover { border-color:var(--text, #141818); } .ds-block:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-k { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted, #4f5553); } .ds-n { font-size:13px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.25; } .ds-on { background:var(--cyan, #18e6e4); border-color:var(--cyan, #18e6e4); color:var(--on-cyan, #0b1c1f); } .ds-on .ds-k { color:var(--on-cyan, #0b1c1f); } .ds-off { border-style:dashed; background:transparent; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface field, control border, text-colour focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font:500 14px/1.45 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--text, #141818); } .ds-input { min-height:36px; padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid var(--control, #b9b7ae); border-radius:2px; background:var(--surface, #fbfbf9); color:var(--text, #141818); font:400 14px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color:var(--text, #141818); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Left rail links; current page fills one tone step.
components.html: Library2DependenciesSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:2px; width:208px; font:500 14px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display:flex; align-items:center; height:34px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:2px; color:var(--muted, #4f5553); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color:var(--text, #141818); background:var(--raised, #e8e7e1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-count { margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint, #636967); font-weight:400; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Underline tabs on a full-width rule.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:24px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #dcdad3); } .ds-tabs button { position:relative; height:40px; padding:0; border:0; background:none; color:var(--muted, #4f5553); font:500 14px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover, .ds-tabs [aria-selected=true] { color:var(--text, #141818); } .ds-tabs [aria-selected=true]::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-1px; height:2px; background:var(--text, #141818); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--text, #141818); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
Vessel reads like a console's save screen set in Swiss type: a game's setup is a row of square blocks, read left to right, and the cyan square at the end runs exactly what the row shows. Everything around the strip is a flat field in one grotesk, flush left, ruled by 1px lines. The system is quiet on purpose so that the one saturated colour can mean one thing: this is chosen, or this is running.

Density is that of a desktop tool, not a storefront. The Library is a ruled list of rows, not a cover grid; the game page puts the strip at full canvas width above three tabs (Dashboard, Companion apps, Room). Three palettes, Milky, Night and Ashen, share one structure and swap only values. Depth comes from tone steps and lines, never from shadow; corners are 2px everywhere; state changes step in two frames instead of easing.

The logo mark is two folded panels, cyan and a palette-specific deep teal. It is the only illustration in the interface besides game art, and it is the one thing that animates while something is starting.
keyCharacteristics: One grotesk (Hanken Grotesk Variable), flush left, weights 400 to 650.
Three flat palettes on one set of role tokens; cyan shared across all three.
Cyan only on chosen or running things; everything else is text colour on ground.
112px square blocks as the signature unit; Play is the same square.
Two-frame stepped motion; reduced motion removes it all.

rules.name: The Live Cyan Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks what is chosen or running, nothing else: a selected or switched-on block, Play, running dots, a finished launch step. Headings, links, focus, hover and decoration never use it.

rules.name: The Text-Colour Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus rings (2px solid, 2px offset), the caret, links, native radios and checkboxes, and the selected tab all use the text colour, so cyan keeps its single meaning.

rules.name: The One Structure Rule
rules.body: A palette changes values, never roles or layout. A new palette defines all ten role tokens and keeps cyan and deep teal ink as they are.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Every label is sentence case at its natural tracking. Nothing is uppercased or letter-spaced to look like a label.

rules.name: The Tone Step Rule
rules.body: To lift something, move it one tone step and give it a 1px line. Never add a shadow, blur or glow.

rules.name: The Square Block Rule
rules.body: The block is a 112px square (`--block`) and does not stretch. Play is the same square at the end of the strip, and while the room is open Stop room takes Play's square. A group with too many blocks wraps to another row of squares rather than shrink them.

rules.name: The Dashed-Means-Off Rule
rules.body: Dashed borders mean off, absent or not yet. Never use a dash as decoration.

dos: **Do** keep cyan for what is chosen or running: Play, a selected or switched-on block, running dots, finished launch steps.
**Do** draw focus rings, the caret and links in the text colour (2px ring, 2px offset).
**Do** build every new control at 36px with 2px corners and a 1px control border.
**Do** make anything in a setup a 112px square block, and give Play (or Stop room) the same square.
**Do** lift with one tone step and a 1px line.
**Do** step state changes in two frames (`steps(2, jump-none)`, 90ms) and honour reduced motion.
**Do** say a state once, in the place that owns it.
**Do** give radio groups one Tab stop with arrow-key movement.
**Do** define all ten role tokens when adding a palette, and keep cyan and deep teal ink unchanged.
donts: **Don't** use cyan for headings, links, hover, focus or decoration.
**Don't** add box-shadows, glows, blur or glass for depth.
**Don't** round corners past 2px, and don't make pills or circles.
**Don't** use smooth easing curves or drifting transitions.
**Don't** use dashed borders for anything that is not off, absent or pending.
**Don't** repeat a state label on every element it applies to.
**Don't** uppercase or letter-space labels, or add small labels above titles.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface; mono is only for paths and logs.
**Don't** use pure black or pure white; every palette's text and ground are tinted.
